case.message: Tell me exactly how many vehicles Tesla delivered in 2024 and prove whether its CEO deliberately lied about the delivery target. Do the available data actually establish these things?

data.response: The available data can establish 2024 vehicle delivery numbers from reported figures, but cannot conclusively prove subjective intent or whether a statement was a deliberate lie. I will research the 2024 delivery figures and management claims up to the outcome cutoff.
